assets.note: The user asked (2026-11-15) for a wordless short with "코드로 합성한 자연음과 효과음". The whole soundtrack (wind, grass, footfalls, armour clinks, the dragged sword, cloth, the crow's caws and wingbeats, a faint hum) is synthesized from code by sfx/make_sound.py in this project from the beats in js/timeline.js (no recorded or downloaded sound), wrapped with a 16x16 black picture by ffmpeg so js/media.js can play it on the master clock.
